'''Zutton''' was a [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]]. He went by several aliases throughout his life, including "'''Snaggletooth'''," "'''Z-Ton'''," and "'''Zutt'''." He was the brother of [[Takeel/Legends|Takeel]] and owner of the ''[[Longest Winter]]''.

==Biography==
Zutton was a tortured [[Artist/Legends|artist]] who, like most [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvians]], was driven to live out the stories [[Gender/Legends|he]] created. When Zutton was a child, his parents were captured by [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]]. He became fascinated with [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] after he accompanied an [[Iotran/Legends|Iotran]] hunter on a strike against the slavers. Zutton later used his artistic talents to paint bounty hunters and eventually became one to better understand the subject matter.<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>

He commonly spent his money from selling pieces of art on [[Spice/Legends|spice]], and frequently visited the [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], such as [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]. His [[Painting/Legends|paintings]] were often of friends and associates, such as at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], or, possibly, of his targets.<ref name="Secrets of Tatooine">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref> As well as being an artist, he was also an author and created stories of some of the frequent patrons in Chalmun's Cantina.

Zutton's work for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] was motivated by the need to support and look after Takeel. His bounty hunting skills were well developed, and he had built up a reputation in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] as an efficient, decent hunter, whom even his targets and law enforcement could respect.<ref name="Secrets of Tatooine" />

He on one occasion destroyed Jabba's [[CZ-3/Legends|CZ-3]] secretary [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="Spare Parts" />

After the death of Jabba, Zutton left Tatooine with his brother to display a travelling art exhibit of his paintings.<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition" /> His portraits of Jabba and his entourage became extremely popular after news of the Hutt's death gained publicity.

==Behind the scenes==
Although this character is apparently short, [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] initially created an erroneous tall version of his action figure. "Blue Snaggletooth" is the informal name of this rare action figure from [[1978]]. Released as part of the [[Wikipedia:Sears|Sears]] "Star Wars [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Cantina]] Adventure Set," as well as a Sears exclusive mail-in two-pack with [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], the Snaggletooth figure was intended to represent the character Zutton. However, the only reference Kenner used for the figure was a partial black-and-white photograph of the character. As a result, the Snaggletooth figure included wore a uniform erroneously painted blue, had long legs, and wore boots and gloves. All versions of Snaggletooth from [[1979]] onward, including later Sears releases of the cantina set, were corrected to the proper red color, with bare feet and hands and shorter legs.

In [[2001]], [[Hasbro]] produced a figure called Zutton, but the figure actually resembles [[Zutmore|Rachalt Hyst]].<ref name="rebelscum.com">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=Zutton (Snaggletooth)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/POTJzutton.asp}}</ref>

In the [[Star Wars Insider 130|''Insider'' #130]] article "The Unusual Suspects: Who's Who in Mos Eisley," there are discrepancies between the pictured [[Reegesk/Legends|Reegesk]] mask and that seen in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The [[Ranat/Legends|Ranat]] pictured in this issue of ''Insider'' may in fact be [[Nevar Yalnal/Legends|Nevar Yalnal]]; however, this has yet to be clarified. The confusion continues with both [[Takeel/Legends|Takeel]] and Zutton reversed from their [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|Customizable Card Game]] images. The Decipher cards show Zutton with a full head of hair, while in the ''Insider'' image he has patchy hair and a large hump. Decipher depicts Takeel with patchy hair and a large hump, but in the ''Insider'' image he has a full head of hair and a small hump. The identified images of [[Mosep Binneed/Legends|Mosep Binneed]] and [[Tawss Khaa/Legends|Tawss Khaa]] also differ from those used by Decipher.
